---
title: "How do I estimate a value between two recorded x positions?"
---

## Question

How do I estimate a value between two recorded x positions?

## Decide which method fits

Check that x and y are aligned, with unique x positions; confirm the requested target lies within observed x; interpolate between its neighbors.

## Worked example: Nile

```{r}
#| eval: false
d <- ru_data("Nile")
estimate <- ru_apply("interpolation", d, x="year", y="flow",
                     threshold=1900.5)
stopifnot(is.finite(estimate$y))
```

The estimate connects recorded annual flow values with a straight line at a midway year. There is no actual half-year flow measurement here; interpolation is a mathematical approximation, not direct evidence.

## Apply to another dataset

```r
ru_apply("interpolation", your_data, x="position", y="value", threshold=your_position)
```

Estimating beyond the observed range is extrapolation and requires a different justification. Duplicated x positions must be resolved first.

Review assumptions and available input conditions with `ru_plan("interpolation")`. A valid computation does not itself verify the underlying study design.
